general_information.Syllabus Name: Graduation Thesis (For Computer Science)_Luận văn tốt nghiệp (ngành Khoa học máy tính)
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (500h) = 22.5h contact hours + 1.5h thesis defense + 476h self-study
general_information.Pre-Requisite: - Student must pass Machine Learning (AIL30x). - Pass OJT201 - Pass 80% of total credits (VOVxxx and OJT excluded)
general_information.Description: The Graduation Thesis is an integrative experience that brings together various components of the undergraduate computer science studies in a more applied setting and under a new perspective. It enables students to further their knowledge and skills which they have found to be especially interesting or beneficial to them. As part of the course, students will learn about all aspects of the process of developing and carrying out the graduation thesis and gain an understanding of standards and expectations needed to successfully complete their dissertation. This thesis project will be completed by a group of 2-3 computer science students. Each thesis of student(s) will be supported by a supervisor, who will provide them with essential guidance in conducting a research, writing a thesis in a formal format and defending their arguments in front of the examination board.
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Divide and schedule work (3)Attend all scheduled meetings with supervisor (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board
general_information.Note: On-going assessment: - Presentation: 15% (5% from other student group- peer review, 10% from supervisor) - Plan: 15% (15% from supervisor) - Implementation: 70% (70% from supervisor where 50% from board review of code and data, 10% from prototype documentation, 10% report of experimentation and transfer) Final Project Result = On-going assessment (3 Reports) x 50% + Final Defense Mark (by Committee) x 50% Completion Criteria: Completion Criteria: • On-going Criteria: after 7 weeks: 2 reports >=5 • On-going assessment >=5 • Final Defense >=4/10 • Final Result >=5

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: • Report 1: Presentation• Report 2: Plan• Report 3: Implementation
assessments.Grading Guide: • Based on the schedule in the syllabus, each group report will be evaluated by the group supervisor. This evaluation is called progress assessment. • Individual mark for each progress assessment report is decided by the group supervisor and is assessed on the basis of the actual contribution by that individual to the group report. The individual mark can be lower or higher than the group mark and is in the range from 0% to 120% of the group mark where the average score of group members cannot be more than group mark.
assessments.Note: 50% of Final CP Mark with weight (On-going assessment) '- Presentation: (Report 1) 15% (5% from other student group(peer review), 10% from supervisor) - Plan: (Report 2) 15% (15% from supervisor) - Implementation: (Report 3) 70% (70% from supervisor where 50% for code and data, 10% for prototype documentation, 10% report of experimentation and transfer)

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Combination of all relevant acquired knowledge, and research and presentation skills
assessments.Grading Guide: • Oral thesis defense mark is given by each member of referee committee for each student on oral thesis defense. This personal mark is the average of all member of referee committee. • Total Oral thesis defense time for each group is 90 mins. Each student must make his or her own presentation.
assessments.Note: Referee committee give mark for each student 1st times: before defense (based on thesis) Referee committee give mark for each student 2nd times: after defense (based on student's performance on oral thesis defense) (Final defense mark = evarage mark of 1st and 2nd times for each student)
